name: sudtoolkit-metrics
description: Cloudflare Worker that receives usage events from sudtoolkit.org. Separate from the app, which ships no dependencies and stays on GitHub Pages.

scripts.summary: wrangler d1 execute sudtoolkit-metrics --remote --command "SELECT role, location, COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) devices, COUNT(*) events FROM events GROUP BY role, location ORDER BY events DESC"
scripts.count: wrangler d1 execute sudtoolkit-metrics --remote --command "SELECT COUNT(*) rows, COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) devices, MIN(received_at) first, MAX(received_at) latest FROM events"
